build_symmetric_alignment: run the script to build symmetric word alignments for a translation dataset using fast_align and mosesdecoder
run_forward_alignment: run fast_align in forward direction on joined source-target sentence pairs to produce word alignments
run_backward_alignment: run fast_align in reverse direction on joined source-target sentence pairs to produce backward word alignments
symmetrize_alignments: symmetrize forward and backward alignments using a mosesdecoder heuristic like grow-diag-final-and
create_joined_file: create a joined file by concatenating source and target sentences with the ||| delimiter
